title: AI Museum Dataset Site
tagline: Web-based visualization to support an independent study in Fall 2025
summary: is a research artifact supporting a 2025-2026 independent study on multimodal AI and cultural heritage sites.

title: Born in the Anthropocene
tagline: An interactive narrative exploring a sustainable future based in collective welfare and critical thought
summary: is a 3-part interactive narrative implemented using Twine and p5.js. Users navigate a society founded on collective welfare, postmodern education, and multigenerational, communal family structures.
role: Writer, Graphics Artist, Twine Developer, p5.js Developer

title: PotLuck
tagline: A culturally responsive, food-focused social network
summary: is a social networking application that connects users from marginalized backgrounds through food. Users share recipes, grocery stores, dinner parties, and more to connect with people of similar cultural background.

title: Alt Text Resource Build
tagline: A digital guide to artistic/poetic alt text built for the Fulton County Public Arts Future Lab
summary: is a RESOURCE developed to complement the Fulton County Public Arts Future Lab's celebration of the 36th Anniversary of the passing of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).
